title: [spec-gap][R-LOADNG-010] SEQNUM_LIFETIME 600 s not implemented in any stack
description:
Spec B2.2 table: SEQNUM_LIFETIME 600 sec 'Sequence number validity'. Classification: not-implemented.

Evidence: rg -i 'seqnum_lifetime|seq_num_lifetime' across python/src, rust/, lichen/subsys matches only the spec line (spec/appendix-loadng.md:30). Note: python GRADIENT_TIMEOUT_MS=600_000 (python/src/lichen/gradient.py:28) is the gradient-table expiry from 05-routing section 11 — numerically equal but a different parameter; do not conflate.

Suggested placement: define the semantic (when a cached sequence number may be treated as stale/reset, per draft-ietf-roll-aodv-rpl), then implement consistently in all three stacks, or amend the appendix if the parameter is redundant with ROUTE_TIMEOUT/GRADIENT_TIMEOUT.
